weights: For a source CCX at PushCondition depth d, w=2^-(d+g), where g=1 iff c_condition is present, otherwise0. Uses only operation nesting and guard presence.
proxy: For a repeated-product proposal U, sum(w_i) - (1-product(1-w_i)). This assumes independent fair guard events only as an allocation heuristic, without sampling actual guard values.
proxy_rank: Sort descending proxy, ties lexicographically by(start,end,use_indices).
density_rank: Sort descending proxy/(end-start), same lexicographic ties.
eligibility: Immutable symbolic repeated-product identities, universal-zero donor proof, raw source touch/control fences, lexical condition boundaries. Greedy allocator rejects overlapping source uses and donor lifetimes.
exactness: Ranking selects among universally exact rewrites; it does not establish equalities or replace proof. Conservative Boolean identities and the HMR/CZ gadget plus full source-bound verifier supply the equivalence obligations.
schedules: Final67 and both95 schedules are fixed and separately frozen before their own measurements. Checkpoint metrics are reported only; no packet-selected stopping or in-run rank/cap changes.
